{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Bouncer}}
A '''bouncer''' was a job in which a person provided security outside certain establishments. [[Snufftalon]] was a bouncer at [[Shilley's]]. Circa [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Tork]] was a bouncer at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]].
